description.en: Konek is a landing page for mobile operators, internet providers, and mobile apps: compare prepaid, postpaid, and home internet plans, let visitors check coverage in their city, answer questions, and promote careers.
description.id: Konek adalah landing page untuk operator seluler, penyedia internet, dan aplikasi mobile: bandingkan paket prabayar, pascabayar, dan internet rumah, cek jangkauan per kota, jawab pertanyaan, dan promosikan lowongan karier.
